defect: the synchronizer's asynchronous reset is OR-ed with a combinational compare of a data counter
rationale: arst = rst | (hold_cnt == MaxHold) is a data-driven asynchronous reset: decode glitches of the counter can asynchronously set sync_reg, and the timeout it ends is itself driven by a register clocked in the same domain.
author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Converted to SystemVerilog and built the surrounding logic around the two-flop reset synchronizer.

labels.note: A data-dependent timeout drives an asynchronous reset input.
